title: Refinance the property
summary: Size and source new debt, pay off the old loan and decide what to do with any proceeds.
outlineSteps: Read the current loan's prepayment and breakage terms
Test whether refinancing pays after its costs
Size the new loan on current coverage and loan-to-value
Request quotes and compare structures side by side
Choose the lender and sign the term sheet
Order the appraisal and third-party reports the lender requires
Get investor or partner approval where the operating agreement requires it
Close the new loan and pay off the old one
Decide what to do with any proceeds
